national_news.title: PM Modi to attend 23rd ASEAN-India and 21st East Asia Summit in Philippines
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit the Philippines for a two-day visit to attend the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit in Manila.
India's trade with the entire ASEAN region currently stands at approximately 122 billion US dollars.
The engagement is a key building block of India's Act East Policy, focusing on regional economic cooperation, peace, and stability.

national_news.title: Defence Minister addresses Air Force Commanders' Conference in New Delhi
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh called for bolstering intelligence, surveillance capabilities, and operational readiness at the Air Force Commanders' Conference in New Delhi.
Stressed the need for the Indian Air Force (IAF) to develop dedicated doctrines and architectures for emerging domains like electronic, cyber, and space warfare.
Commended the IAF for its professionalism and execution during and after Operation Sindoor.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet approves Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum and key subsidy schemes
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the development of the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum in the North and South Block complex in New Delhi.
Approved Nutrient Based Subsidy rates for Rabi Season 2026-27 on Phosphatic and Potassic fertilisers with a tentative budgetary requirement of approximately Rs 62,370 crore.
Approved the continuation of the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units under PMMY and the Stand-Up India Scheme up to March 31, 2031.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Presents Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025-26
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu presented the Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 awards in New Delhi, convened by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA).
Visakhapatnam, Jabalpur, and Lucknow emerged as top performers in the million-plus population category, while Ahmedabad and Sanand topped the newly introduced 'Swachh Shehar Jodi' category.
The 2025-26 edition introduced specialized honours for Swachh River Front Town, Swachh Coastal Town, and Clean Himalayan City, with 60 national awards announced across seven categories.

national_news.title: Ministry of Home Affairs Rationalises Indian Visa Regime to Nine Main Categories
bullets: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) simplified India's visa framework by reducing main visa categories from 13 to nine and sub-categories from 49 to 23.
Renamed the Tourist Visa to 'Visitor Visa', divided into V-1 (30-day short-term visits) and V-2 (1, 5, or 10-year validity for longer visits and mountaineering).
Consolidated Medical Visas into M-1 (conventional medicine) and M-3 (AYUSH treatment), alongside M-2 and M-4 attendant visas to boost the 'Heal in India' initiative.

national_news.title: Russia and Ukraine Reach Agreement in Principle on Prisoner Exchange in Abu Dhabi Talks
bullets: Russia and Ukraine agreed in principle to a major prisoner-of-war (POW) exchange following US-mediated negotiations held in Abu Dhabi.
The diplomatic discussions were facilitated by US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, representing one of the largest potential humanitarian prisoner releases of the conflict.
Ukrainian leadership advocated for direct European participation in subsequent negotiations regarding security guarantees and continental defense infrastructure.

national_news.title: Government Invites Fresh Applications Under Extended PLI Scheme 2.0 for Medical Devices
bullets: The Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers invited fresh applications under the Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Promoting Domestic Manufacturing of Medical Devices (PLI-MD 2.0).
The scheme has been extended up to 2035-36 with a total financial outlay of approximately ₹2,700 crore.
Revised guidelines remove the minimum sales threshold, lower minimum investment criteria, and allow companies three years to establish facilities across four target medical device segments.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Distributes Ration Cards and Highlights Welfare Initiatives at Gyan Bhawan Drive
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister distributed new ration cards to BPL families and PDS licences to shopkeepers in Patna, confirming that 2.09 crore ration cards have been issued across the state so far.
The state administration mandated that newly applied ration cards will be issued within a timeline of 30 days.
Key state coverage statistics highlighted include connecting nearly 9.25 crore people to Ayushman Bharat cards and providing 125 units of free electricity to 1.92 crore rural residents.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Extends Deadline for Free Sugarcane Seed Scheme Application via Cane Care Portal
bullets: The Bihar Sugarcane Industry Department extended the application deadline for its free sugarcane seed distribution scheme to November 25 via the 'Cane Care' portal.
The scheme covers both sugar mill and non-sugar mill areas, allowing eligible tenant and non-tenant farmers to apply for cultivating between 0.25 acre and 2.5 acres.
The state government will bear all associated transportation costs, including loading and unloading, to deliver high-quality seeds to fields.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves DA Hike, MACPS for ULBs, and 'Bihar Ki Beti Startup Challenge Scheme'
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved a Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR) hike effective July 1, 2026, increasing 7th Pay Commission DA by 3% (from 60% to 63%), 6th CPC by 7%, and 5th CPC by 14%.
Approved the implementation of the Modified Assured Career Progression Scheme (MACPS) for regular employees of Urban Local Bodies to ensure periodic financial advancement.
Launched the 'Bihar Ki Beti Startup Challenge Scheme' running from FY27 to FY30 to assist a maximum of 2,100 female students in higher education turn business ideas into practical ventures.

bihar_news.title: SC Clarifies Gold Possession Limits and Source Disclosure Rules During IT Raids
bullets: A Supreme Court bench comprising Justice K.V. Viswanathan and Justice Arun Palli ruled that non-seizure of gold and its legal ownership are distinct legal matters, requiring individuals to prove the legitimate source of gold during investigations.
The ruling overturned a Patna High Court order, restoring disproportionate assets proceedings initiated by the Bihar Vigilance Department against former Bihar CDPO Phoolpari Kumari.

The Supreme Court clarified that standard non-seizure threshold limits during Income Tax raids (500g for married women, 250g for unmarried women, and 100g for men) do not grant automatic immunity from disclosing the source of acquisition.

bihar_news.title: Centre to Launch Evening Courts on Pilot Basis in Delhi, Bihar, and Andhra Pradesh
bullets: Union Minister of State for Law and Justice Arjun Ram Meghwal announced a pilot project to institute evening courts in Delhi, Bihar, and Andhra Pradesh to reduce pending court cases.

The initiative involves extending operational hours of existing daytime courtrooms and engaging retired judges to preside over additional evening proceedings in coordination with respective High Courts.

The initiative aims to optimize existing judicial infrastructure without creating new court buildings, alongside promoting alternative dispute resolution mechanisms like Lok Adalats and pre-litigation mediation.

bihar_news.title: Patna Honored with 'State First Clean City' Award in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26
bullets: Patna was conferred the 'State First Clean City' award in the 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 by President Droupadi Murmu.
Bihar Deputy Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary acknowledged the role of Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) officials, sanitation workers, and citizen participation in securing the award.
The state government reaffirmed its commitment to boosting urban infrastructure, sanitation standards, and empowering urban local bodies across all cities in Bihar.
